title: POST /api/v1/analytics/query with an empty `measures` and no dimensions answers 500 DATABASE_ERROR (the engine runs `SELECT  FROM`) instead of a 400 at the entry
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzj9DrVWXkq7joYHGB

Reproduction (a557fa38, stock showcase `objectstack dev --seed-admin --no-compile`, fresh file DB, admin bearer):
1. POST /api/v1/analytics/query  body `{"cube":"showcase_delivery","measures":[]}`
2. also `{"cube":"showcase_delivery","measures":[],"dimensions":[]}` and `{"cube":"showcase_task","measures":[]}` (auto-inferred cube)

Expected: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED at the entry naming the problem (a query must select at least one measure or dimension), the way `filters`, retired keys, an empty cube name and an unknown measure are refused at the entry, and the way the dataset door already refuses a selection that names no measure (#33141).
Actual: 500 `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"DATABASE_ERROR","message":"Internal server error","httpStatus":500}}`; server log: `[sql-driver] DATABASE_ERROR — the backend refused a raw statement (SQLITE_ERROR) … near "FROM": syntax error`, stack through NativeSQLStrategy.execute → AnalyticsService.queryIn. Reproduced on two fresh boots.
Control: `{"cube":"showcase_delivery","measures":[],"dimensions":["showcase_delivery.status"]}` → 200 (dimension-only is legal), so the gap is "nothing selected".

Mechanism: AnalyticsQuery `measures: z.array(z.string())` has no minimum and no cross-check with `dimensions` (packages/spec/src/data/analytics.zod.ts:982); the native SQL strategy assembles `SELECT ${selectClauses.join(', ')} FROM "<table>"` with an empty list (packages/services/service-analytics/src/strategies/native-sql-strategy.ts:1635). Not new since 18.4.0 (same lines at 181ad7d4).

Searched (open issues, none matching): "analytics query empty measures 500", "analytics measures empty SELECT FROM", "analytics/query 500 no measures dimensions", "SELECT FROM syntax error analytics".

QA-source: #33829 · dashboards.cube-query · neg[2]
